source_1.title: Manual de Gestação de Alto Risco
source_1.finding: Septic shock definition/management includes vasopressor requirement to maintain MAP at or above 65 mmHg after adequate fluid resuscitation, with lactate above 2 mmol/L.

source_2.title: Manual metodológico — linha de cuidado de sepse
source_2.scope: Sepsis / septic shock line of care
source_2.finding: Uses a MAP threshold around 65 mmHg in septic-shock identification/management.

septic_shock_map.software_rule: MAP 65 mmHg may be presented only inside an explicit septic-shock context. It must not be applied as a universal MAP normal/abnormal classification.

source_1.title: Linha de Cuidados para Doença Trofoblástica Gestacional
source_1.scope: Haemodynamic evaluation of bleeding in gestational trophoblastic disease
source_1.finding: Shock Index is HR/SBP; values above 0.9 trigger activation of the obstetric haemorrhage protocol.

implementation_corroboration.finding: Current institutional protocols use SI at or above 0.9 as an obstetric haemorrhage risk/escalation marker.

obstetric_hemorrhage_shock_index.software_rule: The 0.9 Shock Index threshold may be exposed only under an explicit obstetric-haemorrhage context and must never become the generic Shock Index threshold.

no_universal_variant_findings.map: No authoritative Brazilian source reviewed establishes 65 mmHg as a universal MAP threshold for all adult haemodynamic assessment.
no_universal_variant_findings.shock_index: Brazilian sources identify condition-specific Shock Index thresholds; no universal adult Brazilian SI cutoff was identified.
no_universal_variant_findings.modified_shock_index: No authoritative Brazilian universal Modified Shock Index cutoff was identified.
no_universal_variant_findings.pulse_pressure: No authoritative Brazilian universal pulse-pressure cutoff for this generic bedside calculator was identified.

bh3b_implementation_rules: Preserve MAP, pulse pressure, Shock Index and Modified Shock Index numerical calculations.
Preserve threshold_classification_applied=false for the generic result.
Do not automatically classify generic MAP against 65 mmHg.
Do not automatically classify generic Shock Index against 0.9.
Expose MAP >=65 mmHg only as septic-shock contextual guidance.
Expose obstetric Shock Index >0.9 only as obstetric-haemorrhage contextual guidance.
Do not invent a Brazilian Modified Shock Index threshold.
Do not invent a Brazilian universal pulse-pressure threshold.
Keep Brazil-context guidance bilingual and available offline.
